about.paragraph1: Mickiesoft is a software development company in Sri Lanka helping global businesses hire developers and build world-class products. Our expertise spans mobile development, web applications, ERP systems, and Microsoft add-ins.
about.paragraph2: Whether you need to outsource software development or build a dedicated offshore team, we deliver reliable, cost-effective solutions for companies in the US, UK, Australia, and beyond.

about.feature3Desc: Iterative development approach ensuring flexibility, transparency, and timely delivery.
